title: [fixed in dev] [2.8.0] Remove of unused files will be destroy functionality in Watchface DigitalStyle
body:
In commit https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/26834de458107dbbc7dc2f3b985bd33a0ace1035, @MilosKozak  has cleanup some unused resources. This is a good idea, but it was deleted some files they are used by DigitalStyle watchface...

wear/src/main/res/drawable/digitalstyle_bg_shape_round.png
wear/src/main/res/drawable/digitalstyle_bg_shape_rect.png
wear/src/main/res/drawable/digitalstyle_bg_none_round.png
wear/src/main/res/drawable/digitalstyle_bg_none_rect.png
wear/src/main/res/drawable/digitalstyle_bg_minimal_round.png
wear/src/main/res/drawable/digitalstyle_bg_minimal_rect.png

Hope we can make a hotfix in coming days, to fix this and other issues.
